scope: Real rtc.NewMediaTrack, SetupReceiver, SetMuted and NotifySubscriberNodeMaxQuality; original MediaTrack listener, dynacast timers and queue. No network, servers, RTP, Rust, SDK or ParticipantImpl execution.
source_boundary: mediatrack.go:636-644 ForceUpdate on every false before receiver.SetMuted; :674-698 publisher gate only, unconditional expected-layer fanout. uptrackmanager.go:120-133 caller does not suppress duplicate false.
fixture: Public SetupReceiver receives a struct embedding *rtc.DummyReceiver with UpdateTrackInfo and SetMaxExpectedSpatialLayer spies; not a bare DummyReceiver unwrapped to nil. VIDEO TrackInfo has per-codec explicit LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH spatial 0/1/2 and SIMULCAST backup policy. No tested implementation copied or patched.
staging: Reuse offline APFS source/cache cloning, local absolute module replacements and pinned Go1.26.0 path. All writable cache/evidence in fresh /tmp/c58-go-*.
case_order: muted-downgrade n1,n2; muted-upgrade n2; zero-muted n1,n2; off-muted n1,n2; unmuted-control n1,n2
warmup: All codecs SetupReceiver at t0, then node HIGH one codec at a time with Wait and full publisher/layer assertions; muted-upgrade vp9 MEDIUM. Warmup validated, excluded from measurement. No invented initial layer.
clock: Go testing/synctest; first advance timers and Wait, then stimulus and Wait, then capture. SetMuted has no internal fixture waits and completes before Wait. Publisher and newly recorded receiver timestamps checked against exact checkpoint and logged.
concurrency_boundary: GOMAXPROCS=1 is required for the controlled no-wait SetMuted sequence. synctest.Wait controls quiescence, not parallel execution. This is not proof of concurrent mute sampling race freedom; -race detects memory races only on exercised executions.

retained_failed_attempt.cause: Inherited C57 GOMAXPROCS=4 permits the original queue listener to sample mute before synchronous SetMuted finishes. Fix fixture scheduling only; matrix and literal expectations unchanged.
observer_differences: zero-muted n1 at1900 missing publisher event
off-muted n2 at1900 missing publisher event
unmuted-control n1 at1900 missing publisher event
retained_failed_attempt.receiver_layers: All 182 samples match literal expectations; 14 initialized codecs, 10 layer transitions including 8 muted, 9 repeated-false events, 16 OFF samples.

normalization: Sort raw codec map order only, preserve full qualities/order/multiplicity. Separate participant.go-pinned project-codecs.py changes codec names only in events and expected_layers; never changes raw evidence.
close_boundary: Call original MediaTrack.Close(false); queue/quality timers stop, residual debounce no-op timers not a cancellation parity claim. End bubble after 2000ms.
timeouts: 600s subprocess limit including build, 60s test-binary watchdog. All checkpoint time virtual.
outcome: Actual results, commands/exits, immutable snapshots and hashes recorded in fresh task work; expectations are not claimed passes.
